title: Disney Worker Caught Filming Upskirt Videos in Star Wars Section
description:
Bodycam footage caught the moments surrounding a confrontation between police and a then Disney Employee accused of taking hundreds of “up-skirt” videos of unsuspecting female guests. The suspect, Jorge Diaz Vega, 26, was taken into custody at Disney’s Hollywood Studios in Kissimmee, Florida, in March 2023 after another employee allegedly witnessed him in the act. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
